scenarios.title: Hide Tasks from the sidebar context menu, then restore it with the real macOS View > Show Tasks Button item; its checkmark follows both the native click and a scripted setting change, and standard Edit menu shortcuts still work.
Copy an issue or Project link in the real macOS window: system clipboard contains the exact GitHub URL; denial shows failure rather than success.
Open an issue, repository or Project view on GitHub from the real macOS window: the system browser receives the exact HTTP(S) target without credentials or unrelated navigation.
Start or Resume a linked workspace from Tasks and issue detail: the real Quirky window activates the correct workspace and keyboard focus, without raising a different application.
